description:
## Why

Third leg of PKIX-g9vc. Adds the user-facing CLI entry point for the LimboCorpus.

## What

1. **Subcommand**: `pkix-difftest run limbo <manifest> [RunOpts]` where `<manifest>` defaults to `~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json` if unset (or stays required, decide during impl — recommendation: required, no implicit lookup).
2. **CLI plumbing** (`src/main.rs`):
   - Add `Limbo { manifest: PathBuf, opts: RunOpts }` variant to `CorpusCmd` enum (`main.rs:73-95`).
   - Add one match arm to `run_corpus` (`main.rs:168-175`) constructing a `LimboCorpus` and dispatching through the shared driver.
3. **Help text** mentions the default filter (~9,700 cases retained) and points at the loader's docstring for filter details.
4. **Output options** unchanged: `--output-md`, `--output-json`, `--title`, `--sample-size`, `--oracles` all flow through.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-difftest run limbo --help` works.
- [ ] `pkix-difftest run limbo ~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json --sample-size 5 --oracles pkix-path` runs to completion against 5 cases.
- [ ] Output JSON matches the existing schema in `baseline-pkits.json` (same emitter; no new code path needed in `report.rs`).

## Depends on

- PKIX-g9vc.1 (validation_time threading) — oracles need to consume the per-testcase time set by LimboCorpus.
- PKIX-g9vc.2 (LimboCorpus loader) — provides the corpus type.

## Out of scope

- Full baseline run (PKIX-g9vc.4).
- New output formats.

## Filed as

Decomposition of PKIX-g9vc. Blocks .4.
title: pkix-difftest: wire 'run limbo' CLI subcommand
